name: SubWF 04C - Human in the Loop Escalation

parameters.notes: Categorizes ticket based on customer message keywords. Maps to ticket_categories table.

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO tickets (ticket_number, customer_id, conversation_id, priority, status, reason, assigned_team, escalation_channel, source_channel, title, external_message_id, sla_due_at, category_id)
VALUES (
  'TICK-' || floor(random() * 90000 + 10000)::text,
  -- Identity comes from the workflow input itself, not from the previous node's output,
  -- so the ticket is always attached to the real customer and conversation.
  '{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer?.id && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer.id !== "null") ? $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer.id : "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
  '{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation?.id && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation.id !== "null") ? $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation.id : "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.ai_output?.sentiment === 'angry' ? 'urgent' : 'high' }}',
  'open',
  '{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer_message || 'Citizen requested specialist assistance').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'DEPI Citizen Escalations Team',
  '{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.channel || 'webchat').replace(/[^a-z]/g, '') }}',
  '{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.channel || 'webchat').replace(/[^a-z]/g, '') }}',
  '{{ ($('Categorize Ticket').first().json.ticket_title || 'Support request').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NULLIF('{{ ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.provider_message_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (CASE WHEN '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.ai_output?.sentiment === 'angry' ? 'angry' : '' }}' = 'angry' THEN INTERVAL '30 minutes' ELSE INTERVAL '2 hours' END),
  (SELECT id FROM ticket_categories WHERE name = '{{ ($('Categorize Ticket').first().json.category_id || 'general').replace(/[^a-z_]/g, '') }}' LIMIT 1)
)
RETURNING id, ticket_number, priority, status, sla_due_at, created_at, category_id;

=WITH created_event AS (
  INSERT INTO ticket_events (ticket_id, ticket_number, event_type, actor_type, actor_name, new_value, message)
  SELECT id, ticket_number, 'created', 'system', 'NexaServe AI', status,
         'Ticket opened automatically from the ' || COALESCE(source_channel, 'webchat') || ' conversation'
  FROM tickets WHERE ticket_number = '{{ $('Create SLA Ticket in Postgres').first().json.ticket_number }}'
)
INSERT INTO audit_logs (workflow_name, event_type, channel, payload)
VALUES (
  'SubWF 04C - Escalation',
  'hitl_escalated',
  '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.channel || 'webchat' }}',
  json_build_object(
    'ticket_number', '{{ $('Create SLA Ticket in Postgres').first().json.ticket_number }}',
    'priority', '{{ $('Create SLA Ticket in Postgres').first().json.priority }}',
    'sla_due_at', '{{ $('Create SLA Ticket in Postgres').first().json.sla_due_at }}',
    'category_id', '{{ $('Create SLA Ticket in Postgres').first().json.category_id }}',
    'customer', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.customer?.full_name }}',
    'channel_user_id', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.channel_user_id }}',
    'request_id', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.request_id || '' }}',
    'execution_id', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.execution_id || $execution.id }}',
    'workflow_id', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.workflow_id || 'CSWF000000000006' }}',
    'program', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.program || $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.program_scope || '' }}',
    'llm_status', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.llm_status || 'failed' }}',
    'guardrail_decision', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.guardrail_decision || 'human_escalation' }}',
    'fallback_reason', '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.fallback_reason || '' }}'
  )
);
